 Rob Usry USA TODAY Nov. 17, 2026, 7:01 a.m. ET Hear this story Argentina heads to Córdoba's Estadio Mario Alberto Kempes on Tuesday to face Costa Rica in an international friendly.
 La Albiceleste are looking to bounce back after a 2-1 loss to Uruguay on Friday at La Bombonera, their first match since Lionel Messi's retirement from international play. 
 Head coach Lionel Scaloni called for a rebuild of the squad after that defeat, which snapped a run of three straight wins since the World Cup final.
 Watch Argentina-Costa Rica on Prime Video The Costa Ricans are in the midst of a reshaping themselves and arrive after a 2-0 loss at Ecuador on Friday.
 Los Ticos finished fourth in their Concacaf Nations League group this fall, missing out on the quarterfinals despite back-to-back wins to close the stretch.
 Tuesday closes Argentina's first international window without Messi, and a convincing result in Córdoba would give Scaloni's rebuild a bit of a boost.
 Argentina vs. Costa Rica prediction, pick
 Argentina should respond to Friday's setback with a full crowd behind them. Costa Rica has lost four of its last six matches, and the hosts just have too much talent.
 Prediction:  Argentina 3, Costa Rica 0
 Argentina vs. Costa Rica channel, start time, streaming
 When:  Tuesday, November 17
 Where: Estadio Mario Alberto Kempes (Córdoba, Argentina)
 Time:  6 p.m. ET
 Channel/streaming:  ViX ( Watch on Prime Video )
